Gives the address of a followed page as the link wrote it

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxConcurrent: 1, maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages.length);
  console.log(result.pages[1].originalUrl);
  console.log(result.pages[1].url);
}

void main();
```
